snippet.title: KILLER INN | Steam Early Access Announcement Trailer [WEB] EN ESRB
snippet.description:
Starting February 12, 2026, KILLER INN will be available in Early Access on Steam. Take part in this high-stakes murder mystery action game, with a special Early Access price available for a limited time.

Play now in Early Access: https://sqex.to/KI_STM_OTH_WE

Please check the Steam News Hub and social channels for the latest information. 
Steam® News Hub: https://sqex.to/KI_STM_NEWS 
Official X: https://x.com/playkillerinn 
Official Discord: https://sqex.to/KI_DISCORD
